description: Official merch listing schema for mock API + State Engine. Gallery media is a separate domain — not covered by these mock APIs.
notes: A merch entry is one shop product listing (draft | reviewing | published | preorder).
Library list/card/table UIs read from the merch entry shape below.
galleryUploaded may appear as lean stubs (id/name only) on the mock entity — there is no mock API for uploading or managing merch gallery media assets (IndexedDB / merchGalleryMediaStore).
Subscription plan attachments are ids/snapshots only; plan CRUD lives under /plans.

price.description: Alias of originalPrice for list cards.

galleryUploaded.description: Lean stubs only in mock API payloads. Full media is out of scope.

thumbnail.description: Optional small preview URL; not a media upload API.

GET /merch.description: List all merch. Optional query.status = draft | reviewing | published | preorder.

PATCH /merch/detail.description: Edit/update a merch listing. Body must include id.

DELETE /merch/detail.description: Delete a merch listing by query.id or body.id.

outOfScope: Merch gallery upload / media library / attach media APIs
